sectorBreakdowns.headline: Bridging the Urban-Rural Digital Divide
highlights: Vernacular e-learning tablets deployed in 12 village schools
Python, data entry, and office productivity modules for youth
STEM mathematics and basic English spoken coaching

sectorBreakdowns.sectorMr: महिला उद्योजकता व बचत गट सहकार्य
sectorBreakdowns.headline: Fostering Financial Autonomy for Rural Mothers
highlights: Spice milling, pulse packaging, and organic jaggery distribution
Micro-credit linkages through local cooperative banks
Digital bookkeeping and UPI digital payment onboarding
sectorBreakdowns.sdg: SDG 5: Gender Equality & SDG 8: Decent Work

sectorBreakdowns.headline: Cruelty-Free Sanctuary for Sacred Indigenous Cattle
highlights: Comprehensive medical triage for abandoned, injured, and aged cattle
Production of Panchagavya organic bio-fertilizers for local farmers
Zero commercial exploitation; lifetime sanctuary commitment

sectorBreakdowns.headline: Restoring Groundwater & Soil Vitality
highlights: Desiltation of rural nallas and recharge of community borewells
Community sapling planting of Neem, Banyan, and fruit trees
Demonstration plots for zero-budget natural farming
